battle.name: 吐蕃分裂時期
battle.brief: 朗達瑪贊普在拉薩遇弒後，吐蕃在拉薩與藏格之間爆發六年內戰，政權幾度易手；同期沙州張議潮起義，逐吐蕃、收河西，東西兩線夾擊。這場內亂沒有留下羅馬短劍的實物，但卡面這件環首直刃短刺劍，正是當時河西與藏地短刀刺擊配盾的戰法底本。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 八四二年的吐蕃帝國已走到末路，疆域自喜馬拉雅東段、青藏高原伸至青海、藏北與雲南西北，鼎盛時有效控制的面積一般估計超過一百二十萬平方公里，但內部的權力從來不只在首都：政體以邏些的贊普宮廷為中樞，與山南、藏北各世族控制的藏格勢力並立，中央靠贊普直屬的宿衛軍與各部落徵發的兵丁維持秩序，地方則由節度使一類官職分節鎮守。八四二年朗達瑪遇弒後，帝國實際上裂成三股軍事力量。一是拉薩的攝政集團，以掌控幼年贊普的廷臣為核心，倚靠宮禁衛兵與都城城防；二是藏格貝氏家族集結的部落聯軍，首領名譯各家不一、漢籍無對應，自山南東進直取拉薩；三是自印度返回的王族支系，據拉薩以外的高原據點，握有宗教與外交上的號召力。三方之外，唐朝以河西節度使司與河湟的鄯、廓二州構成外線防禦；而敦煌沙州的漢人將校自行起兵，逐走吐蕃守軍後轉向唐廷請降，把帝國的邊緣撕開一道口子，東西兩線於是互相牽動。
countriesEn: In 842 the Tibetan Empire was at the end of its road. Its territory ran from the eastern Himalaya across the Tibetan Plateau to Qinghai, to northern Tibet and to northwestern Yunnan, and the area effectively under its control at its height is generally estimated at more than 1.2 million square kilometres; but power inside it was never concentrated in the capital alone. The Tibetan polity centred on the tsarpo palace at Lhasa stood side by side with the aristocratic houses of Yarlung and of the northern plateau, collectively called Tsang. The centre maintained order through the tsarpo's own guard and through the levies drawn from each tribe, while the districts were administered by officials holding titles comparable to jiedushi. After Langdarma's assassination the empire in fact split into three military groupings. First, the regency group at Lhasa, built around the courtiers who controlled the child tsarpo, relying on the palace guard and the fortifications of the capital. Second, the tribal coalition mustered by the Yel-pang family of Tsang, whose leaders' names are rendered differently from source to source and have no Chinese equivalents, which gathered in the south and marched east to take Lhasa itself. Third, a royal line returning from India, holding strongholds on the plateau outside the capital and commanding authority in religious and diplomatic terms. Beyond these three stood the Tang frontier, formed by the Hexi jiedushi and by Shanzhou and Guozhou in Huangshui; and at Dunhuang the Chinese-speaking commanders of Shazhou rose on their own account, drove the Tibetan garrison out and then turned to the Tang court for protection, tearing open the empire's edge so that the eastern and western lines pulled on each other.
people: 末代贊普朗達瑪在八三八至八四二年在位，是這場分裂的直接死者。他在位時把僧侶還俗、寺產充公、禁絕佛僧傳法，八四三年下令毀寺，八四六年更下滅佛詔，宗教與經濟上的清算同時進行，觸動了王族、妃子與噶當等寺院勢力的共同利益，據漢籍記他死時年四十二。八四二年八月，他在拉薩宮中被近侍與廷臣刺殺，凶手姓名各書不一，漢文史料只作諸子爭立、國亂一語，藏文編年史則記為近侍的報復。死後，攝政的廷臣立其幼子為贊普，貝氏的武裝隨即自藏格東進，攻入拉薩殺死幼主與攝政，統治數載。八百四十八年，自印度返藏的王族悉德妥思舉兵誅滅貝氏一系，登基為贊普，分裂期至此終結。河西線上的另一批關鍵人物是敦煌沙州的地方將校：張議潮於八百四十八年八月起兵，與兄弟張議全等逐走吐蕃守軍，其後歷年經營，於八百五十一年取得涼州，至八百六十年入朝受官；其子張淮深在八百六十九年一度收復涼州。河湟一線的漢人將領張燦受唐封為通義軍節度使，與沙州方面遙相呼應，而這批河西漢人將校在往後數十年裡把敦煌與河西各州經營成獨立的軍鎮。
peopleEn: Langdarma, the last tsarpo of Tibet, reigned from 838 to 842 and is the direct casualty of this fragmentation. During his short rule he forced monks back to lay life, confiscated temple estates and forbade the transmission of the Buddhist faith; in 843 he ordered temples destroyed, and in 846 he issued the decree abolishing the monasteries, so that the religious reckoning and the economic one were carried out together and the shared interests of the royal house, of the consorts and of temple factions such as Kadam were all touched at once. The Chinese histories state that he was forty-two when he died. In August 842 he was killed in the palace at Lhasa by attendants and courtiers; the names of the assassins differ from source to source, the Chinese records say only that the sons contended for the throne and the country was in disorder, and the Tibetan chronicle describes the act as the revenge of the attendants. After the death the regents enthroned his young son as tsarpo, and the Yel-pang forces soon marched east out of Tsang, entered Lhasa, killed the child ruler and the regents, and held the centre for several years. In 848 the royal kinsman Tridé Tsuktsen, who had returned from India, rose against the Yel-pang, exterminated them and was enthroned as tsarpo, and with that the era of fragmentation came to an end. A second set of decisive figures lay on the Hexi line: the local commanders of Shazhou at Dunhuang. Zhang Yichao rose in August 848 and, with his brother Zhang Yiquan and others, drove the Tibetan garrison out; he then built up his position year by year, took Liangzhou in 851, and received office at the Tang court in 860. His son Zhang Huaishen recovered Liangzhou for a time in 869. On the Huangshui front the Chinese commander Zhang Can was invested by the Tang as jiedushi of Tongyi, in contact with Shazhou from the other side, and these Chinese commanders of the Hexi went on to turn Dunhuang and the Hexi prefectures into de facto independent garrisons over the following decades.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬短劍：共和晚期至帝國前期，即公元前一百年至公元三世紀間羅馬軍團的標準短刺兵器，雙刃直身，劍身長約四十五至六十公分，連柄總長約六十至九十公分，重量多在七百至一千公克之間，護手作圓形或四翼、六翼式樣，柄尾收成球形或圓錐形。它的體系位置很清楚：短劍不是用來揮砍的，而是配在大型盾牌之後，用來刺擊盾縫與身甲的間隙，節奏由持盾的步兵與後排的投槍手互相配合形成。八百四十二年的吐蕃戰場上不可能有真正的羅馬短劍，因為西羅馬帝國在四七六年已亡，同期歐洲仍在使用的是拜占庭的長劍，而環首的樣式正是從這條線上長出來的。真正與卡面同源的是環首刀這一系：由晚期羅馬帶環柄的長劍，經薩珊波斯與西域，為漢代的環首刀所吸收，漢墓出土的環首刀通長多在六十至一百公分之間；唐代環首直刃的橫刀與儀刀承襲此制，現存於中國國家博物館與湖北省博物館的唐代吐蕃劍直身雙刃、環形柄首、通長約八十五至九十公分，格上飾獸面、劍身常刻吉語銘文，正是這一血統在藏地的實物。與卡面同處一時代的裝備，則是九世紀高原與河西的常規武備：步兵持窄刃長矛、環首短刀、皮盾或木盾與短小弓弩，箭鏃形制簡陋而數量極多；重裝騎兵披馬鎧、人披鎖子甲或皮甲，執標槍與佩刀；攻城用木構雲梯、撞車與擲石器械，糧秣靠犛牛、馬匹與駱駝馱運。卡面短劍所代表的短刃刺擊配盾的戰法，在河西漢人軍與吐蕃步兵手上都以短刀加盾的形式被實踐著，只是形制早已不是同一件東西。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the gladius, the standard short stabbing sword of the Roman army from the late Republic to the early Empire, that is, between roughly 100 BC and the third century AD. It is double-edged with a straight blade, the blade running about forty-five to sixty centimetres, the whole weapon with hilt about sixty to ninety centimetres, and it weighs most often between seven hundred and a thousand grams. Its guard is round or formed with four or six flanges, and the pommel closes into a ball or a cone. Its place in the order of battle is unambiguous: the gladius was not swung, it was carried behind the large shield and used to thrust into the gaps of a shield wall and between the plates of armour, its rhythm worked out between the shield-bearing infantry in front and the javelin-throwers behind. On a Tibetan battlefield in 842 there could be no true Roman gladius, for the Western Empire had fallen in 476 and the weapon still in use in Europe was the Byzantine spatha, and it was out of that line that the ring-pommel pattern grew. What truly shares the card's ancestry is the ring-pommel sword: the long sword with a ring hilt of the late Roman world passed through Sasanian Persia and the western regions to be absorbed by the ring-pommel dao of the Han, of which excavated Han tombs have yielded examples with an overall length commonly between sixty and a hundred centimetres. The ring-pommel straight-edged tang of the Tang, the hengdao and the ceremonial yidao, continued that tradition, and the Tang-dynasty Tibetan swords now kept in the National Museum of China and the Hubei Provincial Museum, with straight double-edged blades, ring-shaped pommels, an overall length of about eighty-five to ninety centimetres, animal-mask decoration on the guard and auspicious inscriptions cut on the blade, are the physical descendants of that bloodline in Tibet. The equipment actually present alongside the card in the ninth century was the standard kit of the plateau and of the Hexi corridor: infantry with narrow-bladed spears, ring-pommel short swords, hide or wooden shields and small bows and crossbows, with arrowheads of crude form but in very large numbers; armoured cavalry wearing horse armour and mail or leather, carrying javelins and sidearms; wooden scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwing engines for siege; and grain and provisions moved on yak, horse and camel. The doctrine the gladius stands for, a short stabbing blade used behind a shield, was indeed practised on the Hexi by the Chinese contingents and by Tibetan infantry in the form of short sword and shield, though the objects themselves were no longer the same.
tactics: 分裂時期的戰法可以分三處來看。拉薩一線，貝氏聯軍自藏格沿雅魯藏布江谷地北上，取桑瑜一帶翻越高山隘口逼近都城，兵分數路，沿途徵發部落兵與牧畜，靠封鎖山口、斷絕中樞對北方部落的聯繫來孤立守軍，而不是靠一次總攻；中樞則以山勢為城、以宮禁宿衛與弓弩據守城門與山道，糧食靠城外的青稞倉與畜群支應，冬季山口封閉使每一次出兵都被壓縮成短暫的窗口。奪權一方在得手後清洗對手、沒收寺院與宮廷的財貨，同時廢除朗達瑪的滅佛令，把寺產歸還僧團，用宗教上的恩典換取僧侶與部眾的支持，這一手在藏地政治裡一直有效。悉德妥思一系自印度返藏，沿途取得僧侶、經論與信眾的支持，八百四十八年在拉薩對貝氏核心發動突擊，速戰速決，殺其首要而收其部眾，以極少的正面用兵完成更替。河西線則完全是另一種打法：沙州起義是城內突發式的奪權，漢人將校夜襲吐蕃官署，逐出守軍、控制城與渠堰，然後以歸義的名義向唐請降，並以地方漢人身分說服鄰州同樣出身的將校響應，涼州的歸順據說正是守軍內部的響應所致，因此吐蕃在河西的防線不是被攻破的，而是自行瓦解的。整體而言，兩線都沒有會戰可言，全是速決與叛變，兵力的正面使用被壓到最低。
tacticsEn: The conduct of the fighting in this period can be read on three fronts. On the Lhasa front the Yel-pang coalition moved north from Tsang along the valleys of the Brahmaputra, came up through the Sangyü region and crossed the high passes towards the capital. It split into several columns, pressed tribal levies and herds into service along the way, and sought to isolate the defenders by sealing the passes and cutting the capital's links with the tribes to the north, rather than attempting one general assault. The centre answered by treating the mountains as its walls, posting the palace guard and its bows and crossbows along the gates and the approach roads, drawing grain from the barley stores and herds outside the city; the closing of the passes in winter compressed every sortie into a short window. The faction that seized power purged its rivals after taking the city and confiscated the property of temples and palace, at the same time repealing Langdarma's decree against Buddhism and returning temple estates to the monastic orders, buying the support of monks and tribesmen with religious grace, a device that worked in Tibetan politics long afterwards. The line of Tridé Tsuktsen, returning from India, had gathered monks, scriptures and adherents on the way, and struck at the Yel-pang core at Lhasa in 848, swift and decisive, killing the leaders and taking their followers over, so that the change of regime was achieved with almost no use of formed battle. The Hexi line was of a completely different character. The Shazhou rising was an abrupt seizure of power inside a city: Chinese-speaking commanders struck the Tibetan offices by night, drove out the garrison, took control of the city and its canals and weirs, and then petitioned the Tang for reduction under Tang protection, using their own identity as local Chinese commanders to win over officers of the same background in the neighbouring prefectures. Liangzhou's submission is said to have come from an answering rising inside its own Tibetan garrison, so the Tibetan line in the Hexi was not broken by assault but dissolved from within. On both lines, in short, there was no pitched battle; everything turned on speed, sudden seizure and defection, and the deliberate use of formed troops was kept to a minimum.
data: 可核的數字不多，但節點清楚。朗達瑪死於八四二年，即唐會昌二年；內戰起於同年，至八百四十八年大中二年統一，前後六年。沙州起義在八百四十八年八月；八百五十一年大中五年，河西十一州歸唐；八百六十年咸通元年，張議潮遣使至長安受職；八百六十三年吐蕃復取涼州，八百六十九年張淮深再收涼州，八百七十五年又失，張議潮本人於八百六十八年病逝。帝國鼎盛時版圖一般估計超過一百二十萬平方公里，學界對吐蕃人口的估算在四百萬至七百萬之間；九世紀前期能徵發的兵員數目沒有可靠記載，敦煌文書只留下零星的軍令與糧帳，不足以推算全軍規模。距離方面，拉薩到藏格首府約一百至一百三十公里，拉薩到沙州直線約一千四百公里，到鄯州約七百至九百公里，到長安超過二千五百公里，情報靠驛騎傳遞需數十日。兵器尺度可作對照：羅馬短劍總長六十至九十公分，漢代環首刀六十至一百公分，唐代吐蕃劍約八十五至九十公分，長矛常在二公尺以上，規格與韌度直接決定陣前能否抵住馬衝。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but the nodes are clear. Langdarma died in 842, the second year of the Huichang era of the Tang; the civil war began in that year and ended with the reunification of 848, the second year of the Dazhong era, six years in all. The Shazhou rising took place in August 848; in 851, the fifth year of Dazhong, the eleven prefectures of the Hexi came over to the Tang; in 860, the first year of the Xiantong era, Zhang Yichao sent an envoy to the Tang capital and was given office; in 863 the Tibetans took Liangzhou back, Zhang Huaishen recovered it in 869 and lost it again in 875, and Zhang Yichao himself died of illness in 868. The extent of the empire at its height is generally estimated at more than 1.2 million square kilometres, and scholarly estimates of the Tibetan population run from four to seven million; the numbers of men that could be levied in the early ninth century are not reliably recorded, and the Dunhuang documents preserve only scattered military orders and grain accounts, too little to reconstruct the size of the armies. As for distances, the capital lay about one hundred to one hundred and thirty kilometres from the chief seat of Tsang, roughly fourteen hundred kilometres in a straight line from Shazhou, seven to nine hundred from Shanzhou and more than two thousand five hundred from the Tang capital, with intelligence carried by post riders taking tens of days. Weapon dimensions give a useful comparison: the gladius measured sixty to ninety centimetres overall, the Han ring-pommel dao sixty to a hundred, the Tang Tibetan sword about eighty-five to ninety, and spears were commonly more than two metres, a specification and toughness that decided directly whether a formation could stand the shock of cavalry.
cause: 直接導火線是八四二年八月拉薩宮中的刺殺，但刺殺本身只是結果，真正的起因有四層。第一是宗教與經濟的清算：朗達瑪要打掉寺院的免稅土地與僧侶的免役特權，把稅源和兵源收回王室，於是八四三年起還俗僧人、沒收寺產，八四六年下詔毀寺，把整個以佛教為經絡的統治網絡掀翻，觸怒了妃子、世家與寺僧。第二是繼承制度的空缺：贊普一死，無論幼主或成年王子都無法單獨服眾，拉薩與藏格兩套繼承主張同時成立，誰護誰誰即掌權，刺殺於是變成雙方各自加冕的起點。第三是邊界秩序的鬆動：八四〇年回鶻汗國崩潰，河西與漠北出現權力真空，吐蕃與唐爭著填補，邊境摩擦在八二〇年代連年不斷，消耗了帝國最後一批能打的兵。第四是地理與體制的天然矛盾：高原上的帝國靠會盟、婚娶和牧業遷徙維繫，首都與藏格距離不遠卻分屬兩套世族，首都一旦失去對北方部落的直接控制，就再無力壓住山南的世族。八四二年的刺殺，只是把四層累積的矛盾一起引爆。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the assassination in the Lhasa palace in August 842, but the killing was itself an outcome. The real causes ran in four layers. The first was a religious and economic reckoning: Langdarma wanted to destroy the tax-exempt land of the monasteries and the monks' exemption from service, to bring revenue and manpower back to the crown, so from 843 he returned monks to lay life and seized temple property, and in 846 he decreed the destruction of the temples, tearing apart an entire ruling network whose tendons were Buddhist, and alienating the consorts, the great houses and the clergy. The second was the void in the succession: with the tsarpo dead, neither a child ruler nor a grown prince could command obedience on his own, and two rival successions, one at Lhasa and one in Tsang, were both valid at once, so that whoever protected the claimant held the power and the killing became the starting point for two separate coronations. The third was the loosening of the frontier order: in 840 the Uighur Khaganate collapsed, a power vacuum opened in the Hexi and in the northern steppe, and both Tibet and the Tang rushed to fill it, so that border friction in the 820s consumed the last troops the empire could field. The fourth was the structural contradiction of geography and constitution: an empire on the plateau held together by assemblies, marriage and the seasonal movement of herds, with the capital and Tsang close together yet belonging to two separate sets of houses, so that once the capital lost direct control of the northern tribes it could no longer hold down the houses of the south. The assassination of 842 merely set all four accumulated contradictions off together.
impact: 分裂期留下的結果超出西藏高原本身。第一是政權形態的定型：八百四十八年之後的甘丹王朝把贊普、僧團與世族的權力重新編排，寺院在八四六年前後的滅佛之後反而得到保護與財產，佛教在藏地第一次成為與王權並行的制度性力量，經典的傳譯、刻寫與藏語佛學的體系化都建立在這個轉折之上。第二是帝國的解體倒數：中央對藏北、阿里與西部高原的控制在內戰中鬆動，八九二年阿里系勢力坐大，甘丹王朝名存實亡，帝國此後分裂為數個互不相屬的割據政權，直到十三世紀才由薩迦重新統一，而那已經是另一個國家。第三是河西的重新洗牌：吐蕃在河西的統治崩解後，敦煌歸義軍以歸唐的漢人政權形態延續數百年，莫高窟在九世紀中後期繼續開鑿，而第十七窟藏經洞的封閉年代，學界從九世紀中後期到十一世紀初聚訟不決，其中一種說法把封洞與沙州歸唐前後的亂局相連；敦煌出土的藏文與漢文文書，成為研究這場內戰最直接的地方史料。第四是絲路樞紐的轉移：河西重回唐朝版圖，涼州、甘州、肅州一線的商隊與僧侶重新編入中原與中亞的網絡，造就了晚唐五代西部的另一種繁榮，也讓這條線上的兵器、工藝與信仰持續東來。
impactEn: The results of the era of fragmentation reach well beyond the Tibetan Plateau itself. The first is the settling of the form of government: the Ganden dynasty after 848 rearranged the powers of the tsarpo, the sangha and the aristocratic houses, and the monasteries, after the suppression of Buddhism of 846, instead received protection and property, so that Buddhism in Tibet for the first time became an institutional force running parallel to royal power, and the translation, the writing out and the systematising of scriptures in Tibetan were all founded on that turning point. The second is the countdown to the empire's dissolution: the centre's hold over northern Tibet, Ngari and the western plateau slackened during the civil war, in 892 the Ngari interests grew dominant, the Ganden dynasty continued in name only, and the empire thereafter broke into several unrelated regional polities, not to be reunited by the Sakya until the thirteenth century, by which time it was a different country. The third is the reshuffling of the Hexi corridor: with Tibetan rule in the corridor broken, the Guiyijun of Dunhuang continued for centuries in the form of a Chinese polity submitted to the Tang, and work continued at the Mogao caves in the later ninth century; the date of the sealing of the Library Cave, Cave 17, is still argued between the later ninth and the early eleventh century, and one reading links the sealing to the disorder surrounding Shazhou's submission to the Tang; the Tibetan and Chinese documents from Dunhuang remain the most direct local sources for this civil war. The fourth is the shift of the Silk Road's pivot: the Hexi returned to Tang control, and the caravans and monks of Liangzhou, Ganzhou and Suzhou were drawn back into the networks of the Chinese plain and of Central Asia, producing a different kind of prosperity in the west in the late Tang and Five Dynasties and keeping the weapons, crafts and beliefs of that line moving east.
result: 戰爭以分裂期告終。內戰方面，貝氏聯軍在八四三年之後一度控制拉薩，殺死攝政與幼年贊普，坐穩中樞數年，其所廢的滅佛令被推翻，寺產歸還，僧團復業；八百四十八年悉德妥思自印度返藏發動突擊，貝氏一系被誅除，權柄重歸贊普一支，分裂時期在六年後劃上句號，吐蕃進入甘丹王朝的相對安定期。河西方面，沙州起義成功逐走吐蕃守軍，涼州因守軍內部響應而歸順，八百五十一年河西十一州悉數入唐，歸義軍自此據守瓜、沙等州，與唐結盟而實為獨立的地方軍鎮；涼州此後二十餘年在唐、吐蕃之間反覆易手，直到九世紀末才漸趨穩定。整體而言，吐蕃喪失了對河西與西北的實際控制，帝國重心收回高原，內亂的損失無從統計，但可以確定的是，能徵發的邊軍、能運轉的會盟網絡與能約束世族的中央權威都已被消耗殆盡，九世紀此後的分裂之所以成為長態，源頭就在這六年。關於這場內戰的記載本身相當有限，漢文只留下諸子爭立、國亂一類的簡句，細節主要靠藏文編年史與敦煌出土文書拼湊，讀者應當留意其中互相牴觸的部分。
resultEn: The war ended with the end of the era of fragmentation. On the internal front, the Yel-pang coalition controlled Lhasa for a time after 843, killing the regents and the child tsarpo and holding the centre for several years; the decree abolishing Buddhism that they had rescinded was now itself overturned, temple estates were returned and the sangha resumed its proper order. In 848 Tridé Tsuktsen, returning from India, struck at Lhasa, the Yel-pang line was exterminated, and power returned to the tsarpo's own branch; six years after it began, the era of fragmentation was closed, and Tibet entered the comparatively settled period of the Ganden dynasty. On the Hexi front the Shazhou rising successfully drove out the Tibetan garrison, Liangzhou submitted through an answering rising within its own garrison, and in 851 the eleven prefectures of the Hexi came over to the Tang in full; the Guiyijun henceforth held Gua, Sha and the neighbouring prefectures, allied with the Tang in name but in practice an independent regional garrison, while Liangzhou changed hands repeatedly between Tang and Tibet for more than twenty years afterwards and only gradually stabilised towards the end of the ninth century. Taken as a whole, Tibet lost effective control of the Hexi and the northwest, the empire's centre of gravity withdrew to the plateau, and the cost of the civil war cannot be counted, but what can be established is that the frontier levies that could still be raised, the assembly network that could still be run and the central authority that could still discipline the great houses were all spent. That the division of the ninth century and after became a long condition traces back to these six years. The record of this civil war is itself thin: the Chinese sources preserve only a sentence such as 'the sons contended for the throne and the country was in disorder', and the details have to be pieced together from the Tibetan chronicles and the documents from Dunhuang, in which the mutually contradictory parts should be treated with care.
